description: This file defines the public API for SD Host Controller (SDHC) driver interface, including data structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes for managing SDHC hardware in Zephyr OS.

methods.name: sdhc_hw_reset
methods.description: Resets the SDHC controller state, clearing errors.

methods.name: sdhc_request
methods.description: Sends a command to the SDHC to interact with SD cards.

methods.name: sdhc_set_io
methods.description: Configures I/O settings for the SDHC, including power, bus width, and timing.

methods.name: sdhc_card_present
methods.description: Checks if an SD card is present in the slot.

methods.name: sdhc_execute_tuning
methods.description: Runs signal tuning for UHS modes on SD cards.

methods.name: sdhc_card_busy
methods.description: Checks if the SD card is busy.

methods.name: sdhc_get_host_props
methods.description: Retrieves properties of the SDHC host controller.

methods.name: sdhc_enable_interrupt
methods.description: Enables specified SDHC interrupt sources with a callback.
